implementedBoundaries: Binding I/O, including initial task loads and terminal persistence, occurs inside awaited durable steps.
Permanent version/source/authorization failures convert to NonRetryableError inside the durable callback.
Generation cancellation, replacement attempts and job retry identities fence late terminal writes.
Narration clears its interval and awaits the final in-flight cancellation check before leaving its durable step.
Workflow callbacks do not dispatch nested Workflows; API polling and Cron dispatch the durable outbox.
D1 atomically claims an outbox before createBatch; payload and owner fences protect newer retries.
Expired dispatch leases refund an unconfirmed attempt and retry the stable Workflow ID; failed D1 acknowledgement after successful creation retains the recoverable lease.
Rebuild uses a stable per-job extractor version and proposal idempotency namespace, while forgotten spans and tombstones remain authoritative.
The claim timestamp fences delayed dispatch responses from a replacement lease for the same payload.
